extraction_notes: The supplied six-page PDF identifies YJQ40G10A as an N-channel enhancement-mode MOSFET and names Yangzhou Yangjie Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. as the manufacturer; the requested top-level manufacturer identity is preserved as Yangzhou Yangjie Elec Tech.

Typical Characteristics curves on p. 3 and the drain-current limit curve on p. 4 were manually digitized from plotted traces and rounded to compact readings; no unplotted points were invented or interpolated.
The capacitance figure uses logarithmic VDS and capacitance axes. Ciss, Coss, and Crss table values were converted from pF to F; RDS(on) table values were converted from milliohms to ohms.

The strict MOSFET schema does not provide fields for IDSS, IGSS, gate resistance, gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery charge, thermal resistance, absolute maximum ratings, SOA, or transient thermal impedance as table values, so those values are not transcribed into specs. Their usable plotted curves are retained where represented above.
